scope: Complete surviving rendered tapering windmill/signal tower, full original native14-vertex base plan; plinth and reefing lip, five casement recesses, closed double entrance door and drip moulds, six small upper apertures in recessed framed band, cantilevered circular observation balcony and timber corbels, open wrought-iron loop railing, offset hexagonal glazed timber cabin and metal hip roof, copper time ball and mast/rope. No historical sails/treadmill, demolished cottages, flagstaff/park/site walls/archway, reservoirs, hotel, street, cars, trees, people or interior.

Historical station/sails/flagstaff, unknown-author archives, signs, unrelated and attribution photographs unused. No supplemental photography, copied pixels or generated bitmap. Current full native tower plan and street relationship retained; exact aperture angles/roof partitions/cabin offset/mast height and host contact are estimates.
